renderer: Delivered native Unreal Engine Linux client; the presentations are captures of the same real-time character, not substitute assets or offline character renders.
method: Direct visual review of the three delivered MP4 presentations and the enumerated native 1920x1080 screenshots. Mouth geometry was also reviewed in a native-resolution image crop.

inspected.review: Full-body neutral turn shows the standing character from front, side and rear. Skin, hair, suit, rigid armor and cyan accents are distinct; both arms, hands, legs, feet and equipped props remain attached without elongated limbs or missing materials.

Locomotion, upper-body actions, sustained states, transitions, ground poses, recovery and prop actions are visibly distinct. The delivered clip/state captions are present, and transitions do not show the former broken skeleton or capsule/mesh separation.

Close-up performance contains the original dialogue audio, articulated mouth shapes, gaze and eyelid changes, and a readable emotional shift. The face remains coherent through the speech and settles at the end; there is no substituted face or offline-only model.
Front three-quarter neutral view: coherent stylized proportions, organic left arm, equipped cybernetic right forearm, fitted suit, grounded feet and correctly bound materials.
Rear neutral view: attached shoulder armor, fitted back silhouette, cable/stowed accessories and stable lower-body proportions. No obvious detached or stretched mesh.
Forward-right locomotion is visible with the character's facing preserved and legs/armor following the intended deformation.
Moving upper-body action over locomotion: distinct torso/arm pose with continued lower-body gait and no capsule/mesh separation visible.
Charge release preparation/arm position is coherent, with planted lower body and attached emitter equipment.
Front knockdown has a clearly lowered and bent body configuration, not an unchanged standing pose. Limbs remain connected.
Front recovery is visibly progressing through a kneeling/supporting posture rather than snapping immediately to idle.
Back-impact death is in a distinct falling configuration with the dead state indicated; no uncontrolled limb distortion is visible.
Reload supporting hand and cell are brought together at the emitter, with the CellGrip event visible. Exact contact distances are separately measured in runtime_verification.json.
DeployContact is shown with the character kneeling and its hand at the beacon near the floor. The skinned floor-contact measurement is recorded separately.
Blink anticipation is readable and the previously deployed beacon remains independently present on the floor.
Speech start: visible eyes, brows, eyelids, closed-lip configuration and intact face/hair geometry.
Open-vowel mouth and jaw configuration differs visibly from the neutral frame; the mouth interior and teeth remain bounded by the face.
Mid-speech mouth shape and eye direction change are visible, without facial collapse or a hole through the head.

Concern expression and speech shape are visible. A native-resolution crop also confirms the modeled lip/mouth configuration; the deliberately stylized mouth is not presented as photoreal facial topology.
Later speech has a distinct expression and mouth opening, with eyes, teeth and head surface remaining intact.
The dialogue endpoint is reached and the mouth settles without residual extreme deformation.
Ramp traversal endpoint with the character upright on the supplied room geometry. Foot-contact and pelvis errors are measured by the native verification rather than inferred from this camera angle.
The character is visibly supported across two stair levels with aligned foot/ankle orientation and a gait pose; no inverted ankle is apparent.
The in-client panel exposes camera/display, team, LOD, instance count, locomotion, actions, sustained states, hits/disables and facial controls. Room steps and prop station are visible behind it.
Rear inspection of the reload manipulation: both arms participate in the action and equipment remains attached. Quantitative cell/hand contact is recorded separately.
Rear inspection of the kneeling deploy action, showing the lowered body and hand/beacon placement configuration.
The character has recovered to standing after release, while the beacon's persisted position and lack of drift are measured in the native runtime report.

scope: This report records visual inspection of the listed delivered captures, not a claim of exhaustive coverage of every frame or unbounded pose. Performance measurement is reported separately.
